status: IMPLEMENTED, INTEGRATED and VERIFIED: World composed writer and expected-secondary admission subset; complete modern server mission remains active

authority.backups: Both authoritative .bak unchanged; historical values remain authoritative

contract: Each SendPacket owns its body/frame. One asynchronous permit is held through the complete composed write, preventing interleaved frames and scratch-buffer corruption across suspension.
At most 256 outstanding frames or 4 MiB of framed data per peer; excess closes the transport and wakes waiting writers. Oversize bodies are rejected before size addition. No queued write replay.

RAII holds session/send state through suspended writes and cancellation. Read EOF, malformed framing, write errors and escaping read-handler exceptions retire that writer. Run/SendPacket/Close require the actual single runtime I/O thread.

Existing-character ADDCHAR must match an exact registered nonzero typed Map peer (0x0400 | server_id), live typed main, key, account, and previously planned server/IP/port with valid=false. Exact 18-byte body required.
Accepted secondary becomes valid and not-ready. Only when all expected connections are valid does the original main receive MW_CHARDATA_REQ. This does not transfer primary ownership.

Invalid/duplicate secondary receives original MW_INVALIDCHAR_REQ(char,key,release_main=0). Modern failure policy preserves existing main/account instead of the original CloseChar; account and exact-peer checks are additional protections.

Native Map still rejects neighboring connections and uses one durable primary claim. No secondary authorization or persistence is implied by World admission success. Client wire opcodes/fields remain unchanged.
